lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized into discrete vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. A specific column of five distinct spots is visible dorsal to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontally aligned spots, creating a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges run across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 high-luminance spots across its visible surface area.
dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit exhibits a transition to a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, lower-diameter high-luminance pixel clusters.
